name: Mom
overview: Scripture honors the vital role of mothers, emphasizing the command to honor them as a blessing from the Lord (Exodus 20:12). Mothers are depicted as compassionate and nurturing, providing comfort and care that reflect God's own steadfast love (Isaiah 49:15; 66:13). The responsibility of mothers in instructing and training their children in the ways of the Lord is highlighted as foundational for a child's lifelong faithfulness (Proverbs 1:8; 22:6), while the gift of children is recognized as a divine reward (Psalms 127:3). This study also addresses the experiences surrounding the death of a mother and the unique calling of stay-at-home moms within God's design.
